Jason’s academic credentials include a Master of Arts in Leadership and a Graduate Certificate in Executive Coaching from Royal Roads University. He holds the esteemed Professional Certified Coach (PCC) designation from the International Coaching Federation (ICF) and is a certified EQ-i 2.0 & EQ 360 (Emotional Intelligence) practitioner. He is also a Certified Everything DiSC® Facilitator.

Committed to giving back to his community, Jason serves on the Economic Development Lethbridge Board of Directors and as a Director on the ICF Coaching Education Global Board of Directors, providing him with a global and multicultural perspective. He has also dedicated his time to various charitable endeavours, including KidSport, Kids Help Phone, and The Boys and Girls Club.

Involvement in his community is important to Dan. He has served in different roles on various boards of directors, including as the Board Chair of Chartered Professional in Human Resources (CPHR), the Alberta representative on the National Board of CPHR, and as Board Chair of the Mediation and Restorative Justice Centre. Dan is also a community-based mediator, volunteers in a community-based arts coffee shop, and serves as a coach and mentor for budding mediators.
